g.text: 05 / Revisioned cache, authoritative reads and write isolation
Redis is disposable. SQL revision is authoritative; preview and checkout bypass cached catalog data.
No cache credentials in web config
Outage warning does not hide history
Redis outage falls back to SQL
Valid hit returns a catalog reply
Preview and checkout never use cache
Cache failure does not fail SQL result
New reads select a new cache key
Read path is cards 1–7; a valid hit returns immediately. Last-row mutation and checkout cards describe independent authoritative SQL paths, not extra work
on every catalog GET. Learning controls clear, expire or corrupt the selected cache key.
Static architecture; internal module cards are not additional processes. Full placement: drawing 07; live evidence: independent backend console.
